notes.title: Playable demo updated
notes.content:
Change list:

    Functional save system.
    New types of enemies.
    Some enemies will drop loot upon death, such as ammunition.
    Level and puzzle redesign.
    Combat improvements.
    Improved animations for the protagonist and enemies.
    Sound design improvements for enemies.
    Color grading and lighting enhancements.
    Other bug fixes.

tags.feature: Some enemies will drop loot upon death, such as ammunition.
Improved animations for the protagonist and enemies.
